settings.reference: GLORYS reanalysis, harmonised to the 0.25 degree grid

bootstrap.kind: moving-block bootstrap over test days (overlapping blocks, no wrap)
bootstrap.block_length_rule: median over methods of the e-folding time (first lag with autocorrelation < 1/e) of the daily pooled 50-200 m MSE, capped at n_days/4
bootstrap.resampled: test days (blocks of consecutive days), identical for every method, depth, basin and metric; seeds are not resampled
bootstrap.estimator: per-day sufficient statistics averaged over seeds, then metrics from the resampled sums
